bandReport.notes: Image->printed-page mapping confirmed EXACTLY as briefed: p18=33, p19=35, p20=37, p21=39, p22=41, p23=43; every footer reads TFDD-A-HTM/37C. No mismatch. OPENING SEAM CLEAN: p17 (printed 31, checked but not transcribed) carries Q81-86 all complete, so Q87 starts at the top of p18 and nothing straddles the seam. CLOSING SEAM: p23 (printed 43) is the last image and Q120 is complete on it; the footer still prints '[P.T.O.' but that is the booklet's standing footer, not a continuation of the question paper. Q111/112 share one context block ('From the top of a building...') and Q113/114, Q115/116, Q117/118, Q119/120 each share one; the shared premise is folded into each sibling's stem per the brief. All options read label-by-label off the page; Q117 and Q118 have IDENTICAL option sets and were read independently (not copied). A narrow sliver of the facing Hindi page appears at the left edge of p21 ('5 deg)', '2,' and a Devanagari fragment) and p22 (a Devanagari fragment) - ignored as briefed, no question is missing. Options obscured by the red watermark were resolved by high-zoom colour crops and a blue-channel ink filter: Q90(d)=1, Q92(d)=2 (NO leading minus - confirmed by comparing the glyph's x-offset against the minus column of (a)/(b)/(c)), Q96(b,c,d)=0,1,2, Q100(d)=8q^3, Q103 all four, Q107(d)=64, Q112(d)=H=D, Q119(a)=1, Q120(a,c,d)=1/2,3/2,2. Nothing was left unreadable. Note on typography: in this print the '+' sign renders with a faint upper vertical stroke and can look like a division sign at low zoom (Q89(d) a+b+c, Q99(c) a+b+c, Q100 stem p^3+3pr(p+r)+r^3) - verified at 6-8x as '+' in every case. Out-of-band observation: p07 and p16 are absent from out/2026-2-C/ (the directory jumps p06->p08 and p15->p17); p16 would sit between printed 29 and 31, i.e. in band b3, not here.
